findings.summary: Top-level provenance keys gbif_mode and ncbi_mode are hardcoded to the literal 'mock' with no real-mode branch.
findings.observed_live: All 7 live runs reported gbif_mode='mock' and ncbi_mode='mock' while returning real GBIF usage keys and real NCBI taxids fetched from the live services.
findings.note: The per-species provenance['taxonomy_report'][*]['gbif'|'ncbi']['mode'] correctly reports 'real', so the accurate value is present one level down.
findings.correction: workflows/graph.py now derives gbif_mode and ncbi_mode from runtime evidence via nodes.taxonomy_source_modes(state): the per-species taxonomy_report the provider that actually ran produced. Configuration is never consulted. When no candidate was validated the report is empty, so the wired provider's own declared mode is used and the additive provenance key taxonomy_executed reports False. A provider declaring no mode yields 'unknown'; conflicting modes across sources yield 'mixed'.
findings.before: gbif_mode='mock', ncbi_mode='mock' on every live run, contradicting the nested report
findings.after: gbif_mode='real', ncbi_mode='real', taxonomy_executed=True, matching the nested report

findings.summary: The safety footer is a fixed string asserting the classification came from 'a deterministic Sprint 2 mock of BioCLIP-2' and that 'GBIF and NCBI validation are mocked and were not checked against the live databases'. It has no mode branch.
findings.observed_live: Appended verbatim to every live explanation produced by real remote BioCLIP-2 inference and real GBIF/NCBI lookups, so every live answer carries a disclaimer contradicting the run that produced it.
findings.correction: workflows/nodes.py._safety_footer now takes the runtime evidence and chooses each half independently: the classification sentence from the mode the classifier that ran reports, and the taxonomy sentence from the derived source modes. The mock/mock wording is preserved verbatim. The taxonomy degradation warning names the source that actually ran. The footer is still appended outside model-generated text, so the model cannot author provenance wording.
findings.before: 'Species classification is produced by a deterministic Sprint 2 mock of BioCLIP-2 ... GBIF and NCBI validation are mocked and were not checked against the live databases.' - appended verbatim to every live answer.
findings.after: 'Species classification is produced by real remote BioCLIP-2 inference; the classification score is a ranking score over the model's label set, not a calibrated probability. GBIF and NCBI identifiers come from live lookups against the public GBIF and NCBI services; a source that was unavailable or did not match leaves its identifier null rather than filled in.'

findings.type: explanation states the opposite of the evidence
findings.summary: The taxonomy sentence branches on taxonomy_status 'mock_verified' / 'partial' / else. Phase 4 introduced the real-mode status 'verified', which matches neither branch, so a fully verified candidate falls through to the else clause.
findings.observed_live: For mammal_elephant the response carried gbif_id=2435350, ncbi_taxid=9785 and taxonomy_status='verified', while the explanation in the SAME response read 'Neither mocked taxonomy source supplied an identifier for it.'
findings.correction: workflows/nodes.py._deterministic_explanation now delegates the taxonomy sentence to _taxonomy_sentence, which is driven by the identifiers actually on the candidate rather than by the status label alone, and names each source with the mode that ran. All four statuses - verified, mock_verified, partial, unverified - and the no-lookup case are handled explicitly. The classifier phrase is mode-aware too, so a remote run is no longer described as a Sprint 2 mock.
findings.before: gbif_id=2435350, ncbi_taxid=9785, taxonomy_status='verified', explanation: 'Neither mocked taxonomy source supplied an identifier for it.'
findings.after: 'Both taxonomy sources supplied an identifier for it: the live GBIF lookup returned 2435350 and the live NCBI lookup returned taxid 9785.'

findings.type: deployment capacity observation, not a defect
findings.summary: The Azure gpt-5-mini deployment 'umbrella-gpt5-mini' (swedencentral) returned HTTP 429 rate_limit_exceeded under back-to-back requests.
findings.observed_live: 11 of 13 live requests fell back to the deterministic plan (plan_source='deterministic', plan_rejected=False, reasoning_llm_calls=1). A direct diagnostic reproduced the 429 on the second consecutive call. Token budget was NOT the cause: a successful call used 311 output tokens of 400, 192 of them reasoning tokens.
findings.agent_behaviour: Correct and by design - one attempt, no retry (SDK_MAX_RETRIES=0), deterministic fallback, and provenance that honestly reports the fallback.
findings.status: unchanged by design - informational, explicitly out of corrective scope

findings.type: defect introduced and fixed within the corrective pass
findings.summary: The first draft of the partial-taxonomy sentence used str.capitalize() to start a sentence with the source name, which lowercases the remainder and rendered NCBI as 'ncbi'.
findings.observed_live: 'The live ncbi lookup supplied taxid 32536' in the degraded live run.

calibration_recommendation.label: CALIBRATION_RECOMMENDATION

affected_cases.note: Correct species at Top-1, but 0.4601 sits just above the 0.45 floor and far below the 0.75 identification score, so a correct identification is reported as uncertain.
The expected Canis latrans was present at rank 2 with 0.3866. A 0.0355 margin between two congeners is exactly what the gate exists to refuse, so not_identified is the honest outcome.
The expected Carcharodon carcharias was absent from Top-K entirely. A classifier limitation on this image, not a threshold problem.

calibration_recommendation.recommendation: No threshold change is justified by seven images. The observed remote BioCLIP-2 score distribution is strongly bimodal (0.91-0.95 for unambiguous subjects, 0.21-0.46 otherwise), which the existing 0.75/0.45 pair separates cleanly. Any future calibration should be driven by a properly sized, independently sourced evaluation set - never by this one.

verified_run.explanation: The system identified Loxodonta africana with a top classification score of 0.9364414811134338 and a margin over the next label of 0.8915196321904659. Taxonomy status is verified and the visual evidence was sufficient. Species classification is produced by real remote BioCLIP-2 inference; the classification score is a ranking score over the model's label set, not a calibrated probability. GBIF and NCBI identifiers come from live lookups against the public GBIF and NCBI services; a source that was unavailable or did not match leaves its identifier null rather than filled in.

degraded_run.explanation: Remote BioCLIP-2 inference supports Acinonyx jubatus as the highest-ranked taxonomic label (classification score 0.907, margin over the next label 0.834). The live NCBI lookup supplied taxid 32536; the live GBIF lookup supplied none, and its identifier is reported as null rather than filled in. Species classification is produced by real remote BioCLIP-2 inference; the classification score is a ranking score over the model's label set, not a calibrated probability. GBIF and NCBI identifiers come from live lookups against the public GBIF and NCBI services; a source that was unavailable or did not match leaves its identifier null rather than filled in.
warnings: A live taxonomy source was unavailable for at least one candidate; those candidates are reported as unverified and no identifier was inferred to fill the gap.

remaining_limitations: Seven images across six groups in the main evaluation set, three re-fetched for the corrective live verification. Sufficient to certify integration; far too small for any accuracy claim.
Per-stage latency is still not instrumented; only end-to-end wall clock is observable.

F4 stands: the Azure deployment rate-limits under back-to-back load, so the model-authored path is exercised opportunistically rather than on every live request. Both corrective live runs did reach it (2 LLM calls on the verified run).
Outage scenarios remain injected into our own transports; no external service was deliberately failed, attacked or overloaded.
Text alignment is inert in real mode by design (RealTaxonomyProvider ships no name catalogue), so agreement and conflict are certified against the mock-catalogue provider.
The 'mixed' and 'unknown' taxonomy modes are covered offline only - no real deployment currently produces a per-source mode disagreement.
